text:
samir: Heads-up: seeing lots of 'possible privilege escalation' alerts from SIEM starting ~10:02 after last week's RBAC rollout. Looks correlated to deployment of rbac-controller v2.3.1. Many look like false positives — mostly rolebindings created for service account rotation.

tasha: Can you paste an example alert? dashboard link?

samir: Here — alert id 984321, payload snip:

sec-bot: Auto: alert 984321 - possible_priv_esc - src=rbac-controller tgt=svc-account rotation

Most show 'rolebinding.modify' + no token_activity in 10m window.

liam: We're seeing a batch job that reapplies bindings during deploy — generates audit events. SIEM rule currently flags any binding change with 'admin' in role name. That causes FPs for our rotation job which uses 'admin-temporary' naming.

ashley: We renamed roles for clarity earlier — forgot to update detection. tl;dr: rule too naive.

ops_jun: Proposed quick fix: exclude service account rotations by checking audit.request.user.agent == 'rbac-controller' OR request.user.internalsvc. Also add a 2-step correlation: require token use within 15m of binding change to trigger.

samir: Sounds good. We also need to tweak dashboard to surface 'binding change without token use' and add annotation for deploys.

david: If we change rule, let's add 2-stage migration: 1) low-priority alert + add tag fp_review, 2) after 48h if FP rate >80% suppress. Also add saved search to validate.

liam: I'll open a PR with rule snippet. Example to add to siem rule:

```
condition:
  - event.type == 'role_binding'
  - not (request.user.agent =~ /rbac-controller|k8s-deployer/)
  - not (subject.account_type == 'system:serviceaccount' && recent_token_use > 0)
```

Will include thresholds.

tasha: :thumbsup: Also can we add an eval to detect role rename patterns '.*-temporary' and auto-suppress?

samir: Yes — add regex and link to runbook. I'll update runbook with playbook steps: check deploy annotations, confirm token use, then escalate.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-17 — triage channel #incidents-eng-security. Assigned to samir, liam.

ops_jun: :warning: rolling change to SIEM rule going to staging in 10m.

david: note: make sure audit pipeline latency accounted for — last deploy caused 3–4 minute lag; correlation windows should tolerate that.

samir: Agreed. Set correlation window to 20m. After deploy we'll measure FP rate and reconvene tomorrow 09:30.

tasha: I'll update dashboard panels: 'binding_changes', 'token_activity', 'deploy_annotations'. Will tag with 'fp_candidate'.

liam: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/siem/rules/merge/345 — includes exclusion and 20m window.

samir: Great. Closing loop: after 24h, if FP down we'll promote change to prod. thanks all :rocket:
